Best Rooftop Bar!
Jul 2026 • Friends
Banana Mama Rooftop & Kitchen is hands-down one of the best nights out in Saigon. Ride the elevator up to the 10th floor of the WMC Tower and you land in a beachy, plant-filled rooftop with jaw-dropping skyline views, especially at sunset. Staff are warm and attentive, the vibes are chill and fun. The whole experience feels like a mini beach-club escape without ever leaving District 1. If you’re ever in HCMC, this place absolutely has to be on your list.
